meta.name: pr-to-video
meta.description: Turn a GitHub pull request (a PR URL, owner/repo#N, or 'this PR' in a checked-out repo) into a code-change explainer video — changelog, feature reveal, fix, or refactor walkthrough built from the diff, commits, and files: the input is a code change, not a website. Not a product promo (/product-launch-video) or a no-PR topic explainer (/faceless-explainer). Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 生成代码改动的解说视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你常需要向团队解释代码改动
copy.tagline_en: Generate explainer videos from code changes
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to explain code changes to your team

howto.what: Claude 收到一个 GitHub 的 pull request（链接、owner/repo#N 或“这个 PR”）后，会把它变成一段讲解代码变更的视频。它会读取该 PR 的差异、提交记录和文件，按更新日志、新功能、修复或重构等主题规划分镜，并逐步生成。
howto.when: 当用户提供一个 GitHub 的 pull request 链接、owner/repo#N 引用，或在本地仓库里说“这个 PR”，并希望生成代码变更讲解视频时触发。不适用于产品宣传或非 PR 主题的讲解。

say.text: 把 acme/sdk#42 做成讲解视频
say.note: Claude 会读取该 PR 并开始规划。

say.text: 给当前仓库的这个 PR 做个视频
say.note: 它使用本地检出的仓库中的当前 PR。

say.text: 读这个 PR 链接，生成讲解视频
say.note: 它获取该 PR 并启动创作流程。

howto.what_en: Claude turns a GitHub PR (URL, owner/repo#N, or 'this PR') into a code-change explainer video. It uses the PR's diff, commits, and files, plans scenes by theme (changelog, feature reveal, fix, refactor), and renders.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user gives a PR URL, owner/repo#N, or says 'this PR' in a checked-out repo, wanting a code-change explainer video. Excludes product promos and non-PR topic explainers.

say_en.text: Turn acme/sdk#42 into an explainer video.
say_en.note: Claude reads that PR and starts planning.

say_en.text: Make a video for this PR in the current repo.
say_en.note: Uses the checked-out repo's current PR.

say_en.text: Read this PR link and generate a video.
say_en.note: It fetches the PR and begins the workflow.
